results.title: Revocation bumps the epoch by exactly one
results.evidence: withdrawing one model's authority moved the estate-wide epoch by 4 (0 → 4), one per grant. `revoke_model` loops `revoke`, and `revoke` does `self.epoch += 1` — so a model with forty grants advances the floor forty times. Every descriptor outstanding anywhere in the estate is now stale by 4 rather than by one, and an engine refusing them reports `revoked_epoch` — a withdrawal it was never told abou
